description: Verifies the TeVeS spacetime metric: satisfaction of the spacetime concept, geometric invariants in geometrized units, positivity of the connection in SI units, and the circular velocity of the metric against the MOND prediction and the baryonic Tully-Fisher relation.

checks.label: TeVeS: the inverse metric times the metric reproduces the identity
TeVeS: the metric tensor is symmetric relative to its largest component
TeVeS: the metric determinant is negative, which gives a Lorentzian signature
TeVeS: the analytic connection is symmetric in its lower indices
TeVeS: the analytic connection matches eighth-order finite differences relative to the largest symbol of its row
the SI inverse metric reproduces the identity
the radial and temporal connection symbols are positive
the metric circular velocity at 50 kpc matches the MOND prediction
the asymptotic velocity at 250 kpc follows the baryonic Tully-Fisher relation within 2 percent
